V. 12.
Whoſoever hath—That is, improves what he hath, uſes the Grace given according to the deſign of the Giver; to him ſhall be given—More and more, in Proportion to that Improvement. But whoſoever h•th not—Improves it not, from him ſhall be taken even what he hath. Here is the grand Rule of GOD'S dealing with the Children of Men: A Rule, fixt as the Pillars of Heaven. This is the Key to all his providential Diſpenſations; as will appear to Men and Angels in •••t Day.
